title: TDM: Files Download Manager
summary: Fast, simple download manager for all your files with few ads and full control.
description:
TDM (Files Download Manager) is a fast and lightweight download manager for Android.
Control all your downloads in one clean place – videos, music, documents and any other files from the internet.

Fast & smart downloader
- Accelerates downloads with multi-thread support.
- Stable downloads, even on weak or unstable networks.
- Pause and resume downloads without starting again.
- Auto retry for failed downloads (optional).

Organize all your files
- Group downloads by type: videos, audio, documents, archives and more.
- Sort by name, size, date or status.
- Easy search to quickly find any file.
- See detailed information: speed, remaining time, progress and file size.

Easy to add downloads
- Paste links directly into TDM.
- Share links from your browser or other apps to TDM.
- Detect downloadable files from the built-in browser (if you enable it).

Full control, simple interface
- Minimal, clean UI that is easy for beginners.
- Powerful options for advanced users who download a lot.
- Limit the number of parallel downloads.
- Choose Wi-Fi only mode to save mobile data.
- Enable or disable notifications for completed downloads.

Designed to be light
- Small app size and optimized performance.
- Few, non-intrusive ads – no aggressive popups.
- Battery-friendly background work.

TDM – Files Download Manager is built for users who want a fast download manager, fewer ads and a simple interface without losing control.

Download TDM now and start managing all your files with one powerful, easy download manager.
